name: pages-native
description: Native Apple Pages documents through the macOS scripting API. Preview verified on Pages 14.5.
long_description: Native .pages documents, guarded rich-text edits, native templates and existing placeholders, tables and formulas, objects, explicit exports and PDF/PNG previews. Requires macOS, Apple Pages, Node.js 22+ and Automation permission. Preview verified on one Mac with Pages 14.5. No Accessibility or Word conversion backend.
